name: Project Scope Management
excerpt: Project Scope Management involves managing the scope of a project to prevent scope creep.
notes:
- Project Scope Management includes managing scope creep, which is the tendency for the scope to increase over time.

- Project Scope Management involves defining and controlling what is included and excluded in the project to prevent scope creep.
- It ensures that the project includes all the work required, and only the work required, to complete the project successfully.
